description: Lets an agent ask what went wrong with its own Ollama calls, in sentences with the fix: lost prompt cache and the token where the prompt stopped matching, context overflow, a prompt cut silently to fit, a model running partly on CPU, tool schemas crowding the prompt. Also lists its recent turns, compares them before and after a change, estimates whether a prompt fits a loaded model, and lists which local models fit in video memory. Reads from a running LLMxRay (start it with `npx llmxray` and send Ollama calls through its port 11435). Local, read-only, no account or API key.

env: LLMXRAY_URL (optional, default http://localhost:5174): the running LLMxRay server the tools read from
OLLAMA_URL (optional, default http://localhost:11434): the Ollama daemon, for list_local_models

notes: Runs locally and talks only to localhost; no account, no API key.
Profile claimed by @LogneBudo in #3996; issue author matches the GitHub repository owner.
On 2026-10-17 llmxray 0.8.6 answered initialize and tools/list over stdio (7 tools) with no LLMxRay server running.
